title: The screening call: what is really being checked

videos.script: The first conversation is usually a short call with a recruiter, and people prepare for it as if it were the technical interview. {{call}} It is not. The recruiter is checking a handful of practical things, and whether you can hold a clear conversation about your own CV. {{checking}} Most people who fail it fail on the practical things: the salary question, the start date, the kind of contract, or a CV they cannot explain. {{fail}} This lesson lists what the call checks, prepares the logistics answers in advance, and ends with the two questions worth asking the recruiter.
